statement: Annotated from the Beinecke scan alone (full page and three strips). The page has a patterned tube at the top, a blue scalloped band with two ray bursts, ten nude female figures standing in a green tub, each joined by a tube from the head to a panel holding two label lines, and below left a blue two-lobed pool crowded with about nineteen nude female figures, drained by a stream. Label lines f75v.18 to f75v.37 were paired with the ten upper figures left to right, two lines per panel, from the line ids and unit codes only; that pairing assumes the transcription lists the panels left to right. Lines f75v.50 to f75v.56 stand around the lower pool and are not tied to single figures. Lines f75v.2, 4, 6, 8, 9, 11 are taken to be the isolated single glyphs at the right edge of the top right text column; they point at no drawn object. The count of lower figures is uncertain by one or two.
